CourseRequest.title: CourseRequest
CourseRequest.description: Represents a student's access request for a premium AI course

userId.description: The unique Firebase Authentication UID of the student

userEmail.description: The email address of the student

courseId.description: The custom string ID of the course requested

courseTitle.description: The title of the requested course

status.description: The current verification and activation status of the request

requestedAt.description: The timestamp when the request was made

ActivationKey.title: ActivationKey
ActivationKey.description: Represents a generated unique subscription license key/code

activeDeviceId.description: The ID of the device currently active with this code for single-device restriction

status.description: Whether the key has been claimed

claimedByEmail.description: The email of the student who claimed the key

claimedByUid.description: The Firebase Auth UID of the student who claimed the key

claimedAt.description: Timestamp when the key was claimed

courseId.description: The course ID associated with this activation key

courseTitle.description: The title of the course associated with this activation key

createdByRole.description: Whether the key was generated by the Main Admin or a course-scoped Sub-Admin

createdBySubAdminCode.description: The secret code of the Sub-Admin who generated this key, if applicable

createdByName.description: Display name of the Sub-Admin who generated this key

studentName.description: Student name assigned to this activation key

studentPhone.description: Student phone number captured during enrollment

isFreeEnrollment.description: Whether this key was automatically issued for a free course enrollment

studentAvatar.description: Saved profile photo or logo data URI/URL for the student

SubAdminAccount.title: SubAdminAccount
SubAdminAccount.description: Course-scoped Sub-Admin credentials created by the Main Admin

code.description: Unique Sub-Admin login secret code (e.g. SUB-XXXXXX)

courseId.description: Primary course ID this Sub-Admin is permitted to manage

courseTitle.description: Primary title of the assigned course

courseIds.description: List of all course IDs assigned to this Sub-Admin

courseTitles.description: List of all course titles assigned to this Sub-Admin

avatarUrl.description: Custom logo or profile image URL/data URI for the Sub-Admin

Course.title: Course
Course.description: Represents a dynamic course offered by AI Clipzone

price.description: The displayed price tag of the course

isFree.description: Whether this course is free (no payment QR or screenshot required)

learn.description: Key learn highlights of the course

image.description: URL to the course display thumbnail

isPopular.description: Whether this is marked as a popular bestseller

popularText.description: Display banner text for popular courses

videos.description: List of instructional videos in this course

includeLive.description: Whether live Zoom sessions are enabled for this course (replaces Certificate for activated students)

includeCertificate.description: Whether completion certificate is enabled for this course

isHidden.description: When true, Main Admin hides this course from the public Home screen while Sub-Admin can still generate student enrollment codes

paymentConfig.description: Optional per-course payment QR, eSewa, bank, and WhatsApp override

LiveSession.title: LiveSession
LiveSession.description: Public student-facing metadata for a course live Zoom class (never stores raw Zoom link)

LiveSessionSecret.title: LiveSessionSecret
LiveSessionSecret.description: Protected document holding the Zoom join URL for a live session, resolved into opaque launch tokens

PaymentQrConfig.title: PaymentQrConfig
PaymentQrConfig.description: System payment QR code, eSewa ID, bank and payment checkout configuration

FAQConfig.title: FAQConfig
FAQConfig.description: Dynamic FAQs collection and questions list configuration

SiteSettingsConfig.title: SiteSettingsConfig
SiteSettingsConfig.description: Global website banner, contact info, institute branding, logo URLs, and certificate design & signatures

SupportConversation.title: SupportConversation
SupportConversation.description: Represents a role-isolated support conversation (Sub-Admin <-> Student or Main Admin <-> Sub-Admin)

SupportMessage.title: SupportMessage
SupportMessage.description: A single chat message in a support conversation

course_requests/{requestId}.description: Collection tracking student payment and activation course requests

courses/{courseId}.description: Collection tracking dynamic courses available for enrollment

live_sessions/{sessionId}.description: Collection storing public live class session metadata without exposing Zoom links

live_session_secrets/{sessionId}.description: Collection storing raw Zoom meeting URLs separately for opaque token resolution

system/payment_qr.description: Document holding dynamic payment QR and checkout credentials

system/site_settings.description: Document holding global website branding and settings

support_conversations/{conversationId}/m.description: Real-time messages between student and admin

sub_admins/{code}.description: Collection of course-scoped sub-admin accounts managed by the Main Admin
